messages:
evan: Quick sync 1: the region availability grid is great but the 'Supported deployments' column confuses a few customers. Example: APAC row says "Hosted, Dedicated" but the note about Private being "customer-controlled" is tucked into the legal footnotes. Suggest a short inline badge/emoji next to Private so readers spot it.

park: emoji badge seems fine. maybe use :warning: next to Private in the table and add a one-line hover text. docs platform supports title attribute on badges?

maria: UX note: hover titles don't work in our static site for tables. Better approach: add a small inline sentence beneath the table: "Note: Private deployments do not inherit Redwood's hosted residency guarantees; customers control locality." Also add a tiny example mapping for SDKs.

evan: ok i'll PR the table tweak + include a tiny mapping example for go and dotnet SDKs showing endpoint usage.

docs-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5512  files touched: table, go snippet, dotnet snippet, small note. assigned: @park @maria.

park: good call. i'll proof the sentence and ensure we reference the legal footnote id.

maria: i'll add the go snippet: 

```go
client := redwood.NewClient(redwood.Config{ApiKey: os.Getenv("RW_KEY"), Endpoint: "https://console.private.myorg.redwood"})
```

evan: thanks. let's ship by EOD if legal doesn't block.
